Your data. Your choice.

DW and 225 partners store and access information on your device and process personal data (e.g. IP address) for purposes such as personalised ads and content, measurement, and product development. Our partners may also use precise geolocation data and perform device scanning for identification. Some partners process data based on legitimate interest; you can find more information under "Settings" and exercise your right to object there.

Below you will find a list of purposes and features. You can adjust your preferences or withdraw your consent at any time via the "Data privacy settings" link in the footer. Your choice applies only to this domain.

You can access all DW content without providing your consent.

Certain data is essential for the website's core functions, security, and fraud prevention. This includes anonymous statistical analysis to improve our service. These processes don't require your consent and cannot be refused, as the website cannot function without them.
We integrate external content such as social media videos or infographics. These providers may collect your data directly. Additionally, we and our partners may use precise geolocation data or scan your device characteristics for identification to ensure the content is correctly displayed for your region and device.
We measure how you interact with ads and content to understand what is relevant to our audience. This data helps us and our partners to gain insights into our target groups and to continuously improve the quality of our products and services.
Data may be used to build a profile based on your interests, allowing us to show you relevant, personalized ads and content. We and our partners use this information to make advertising more useful to you and to tailor our journalistic content to your preferences.
We and our partners can store and access information on your device, such as cookies and device identifiers. This is necessary to recognise you as a visitor and to remember your settings (e.g., language or privacy choices).

Settings

On this page, you can manage your data usage preferences. For each purpose or partner, you can either grant consent or object to data processing based on legitimate interest. Please note: Some technical processing is necessary for the website to function and cannot be deselected. You can find more information in the "Legitimate interest" section.
